description: minimumReleaseAge matches pnpm-workspace.yaml's minimumReleaseAge (4320 minutes). Without it Renovate proposes releases pnpm refuses to lock, the lockfile update fails, and the branch ships a package.json the lockfile does not match. internalChecksFilter strict holds the branch back until the release is old enough, rather than opening a PR that cannot pass.

prHourlyLimit is 0 (unlimited) rather than the default 2: the workflow runs once a week, so a per-hour cap is really a per-week cap and a backlog would drain two PRs at a time. prConcurrentLimit is the gate that is meant to bite.

postUpgradeTasks.description: `pnpm update --changeset` writes a changeset for the bumps its own run makes, and Renovate never makes such a run — it rewrites the range itself. The script reads the change Renovate has already made and hands the writing to `pnpm change`. `update` mode rather than `branch` because only per-upgrade mode exposes the templated fields that say which dep in which manifest moved.

packageRules.description: Never raise a published peer range on a consumer's behalf — bumping the `zod` or `next` floor drops support for versions that worked, which is a breaking change dressed up as a chore. `widen` only ever adds a major to the range. Dev ranges still track latest via the top-level `bump`, so the lockfile stays current either way.
Lint and type tooling moves together — replaces the dependabot `typescript` group
Local dev hooks — replaces the dependabot `dev-tools` group

React must move in lockstep with their types — this mirrors the old dependabot `core-framework` group. Listed last so it wins over the `@types/**` glob above. `at any time` only means this group is never held back by a schedule; the workflow cron is still the only thing that makes Renovate run at all.

Fallow decides the CI gate, and a new version can report findings the last one did not. Its bump waits for approval on the dependency dashboard, so it lands once someone has run the audit at the new version.
Dependabot updates the actions (.github/dependabot.yml), because it also updates .github/workflows/actions.lock and Renovate does not.
